review.notes: Word-level cross-check of all 67 physical PDF pages against the OCR Markdown found no dropped words (the only unmatched extraction text is vector text inside the page-16 multi-student distillation diagram, which the embedded figure already shows). No code fences exist in this source, so no fence imbalance is possible; all 35 tables are balanced <table> blocks and heading levels follow the printed structure. Pages 8, 10 and 12 were rendered and visually checked (Table 1 values, equations (1)-(3), Figure 7 caption). Equation (1) needed one spaced-decimal repair. The paper itself prints 'Evolution trough' in the Figure 7 caption and 'Please zoom in, do you agree with DINOv3?' in the Figure 3 caption; both are source typos, kept verbatim. Citation punctuation spacing after inline math is handled by the shared OCR normalizer.
